'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Kingery LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
